transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Lucy. How can I help you today?
Customer: I am so frustrated! My internet connection has been dropping every ten minutes for the last two days. This is completely unacceptable.
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you are experiencing these drops in connection. I know how disruptive that is to your day.
Customer: It is. I work from home and I can't even finish a single Zoom call without getting kicked out.
Agent: I understand. Before we look into your account, could you please provide your account number and date of birth for verification?
Customer: Yes, my account number is 63873226 and my date of birth is 19/08/1974.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Mehta. I see your address is 83 Park Street. Is that correct?
Customer: Yes, that is correct. My name is Vivek Mehta and my phone number is 95973 14843.
Agent: Thank you for that information. I have run a diagnostic on your line and it looks like there is a signal instability in your area. I will raise a network ticket to have our engineers investigate the local exchange.
Customer: Will that actually fix it? I just want it to work properly again.
Agent: The ticket will ensure the engineers can pinpoint the exact fault and resolve it. You should see an improvement in stability shortly.
Customer: Okay, that sounds like a plan. I appreciate you taking care of this so quickly.
Agent: You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I have raised the ticket and the engineers will be working on it now. Goodbye!
